== Title ==
<span lang="ja">作動不能</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分の支配フェイズに2フォースを使用して牽引ビームにつかまった宇宙船を脱出させる（「中央コア」が場に出ている場合、「デス・スター牽引ビーム」には効果がない）。2：相手のロストデッキか「ブラスター収納ラック」からランダムに1枚のカードを選んでゲームから除外する。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「じいさん、牽引ビームを作動不能にしてくれたんだろうな。さもなきゃ、すぐに後戻りだぜ」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Out Of Commission]].

'''Lore''' — Old man, you got the tractor beam out of commission, right? Otherwise turning back at once is required.

'''Game text''' — Choose one.
1: During your control phase, use 2 Force to free a starship held by a Tractor Beam. If Central Core is on table, this has no effect on Death Star Tractor Beam.
2: Randomly take one card from opponent's Lost Pile or Blaster Rack and place it out of play.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore ends with turning back at once, not a real short trip. Game text uses numbered choose-one, ロストデッキ, ブラスター収納ラック, and ゲームから除外.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-outofcommission.gif|Original English face]], [[Out Of Commission]].</ref>
